messages.msg: From Lesson 08 on, the Town News project is split into files: src/App.jsx imports EditorialFeed from './components/EditorialFeed.jsx', which imports CardContainer (default) and LiveBadge and NewBadge (named, from Badges.jsx). Lessons 02 to 07 kept every component in App.jsx and said so as a choice for learning (lecture-structure Section 12); that sentence is no longer needed from Q09 on. main.jsx's import of App is the first import Q09 can explain with Q08's terms (module, default import, relative path).
messages.resolution: Map 09 builds on the split project (src/App.jsx imports SiteHeader and ArticleList from components/), renamed to the plain names of briefs 2026-10-15-07 and 2026-10-15-08; main.jsx's import of App is a Prerequisite row recalled with Q08's terms, used by initial-render.
